wo-jpfa-JR4692.d:
PT Japfa Food Indonesia (Wonoayu)

Job Responsibilities**

* Perform in-process quality inspections at various stages of Process-3 according to established procedures and specifications.
* Monitor critical control points (CCPs) and operational control points (OCPs) to ensure compliance with quality standards.
* Collect and analyze samples for physical, chemical, and sensory evaluation as required.
* Record inspection results accurately and promptly in designated forms and systems.
* Identify and report non-conforming products or processes immediately to relevant supervisors.
* Initiate and support corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for identified quality deviations.
* Assist in investigating root causes of quality issues and implementing effective solutions.
* Verify the calibration status of inspection equipment and ensure proper usage.
* Maintain a clean and organized inspection area.
* Adhere to all safety regulations and company policies.
* Participate in internal and external audits as required.

Job Qualifications**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Food Technology, Chemistry, or a related field is preferred.
* Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in quality control or assurance, preferably in the food processing or feed manufacturing industry.
* Familiarity with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) principles.
* Ability to read and interpret technical specifications, procedures, and quality standards.
* Strong attention to detail and observation skills.
* Proficient in basic computer applications (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite).
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Willingness to work in shifts and occasional overtime as required.

PENGAWAS PRODUKSI FARM

Tugas dan tanggung jawab:

• Mengawasi dan mengevaluasi proses produksi / pemeliharaan ayam (persiapan kandang, ketersediaan Sapronak, kontrol penerimaan DOC, panen dan termasuk data produksi) di Farm agar target produksi farm tercapai
• Mengawasi dan mengevaluasi tersedianya Sapronak untuk mendukung tercapainya proses produksi
• Mengontrol, mengevaluasi dan mengarahkan penggunaan biaya operasional rutin dan non rutin serta mengevaluasi penggunaan aset di farm sehingga tercapai efisiensi Farm
• Menjaga dan mengelola hubungan baik di lingkungan sekitar farm agar tercipta lingkungan farm yang kondusif
• Melakukan monitoring, memelihara dan perbaikan terhadap fasilitas produksi Farm (Bangunan, mesin, peralatan kandang, peralatan kerja dll) dalam rangka mendukung proses produksi yang efisien.
• Melakukan perbaikan manajemen pemeliharaan ayam agar performance produksi farm meningkat dan berjalan efektif dan efisien.
• Mengembangkan SDM di farm agar kinerja dan kompetensi SDM maksimal dalam mendukung bisnis perusahaan yang efektif dan efisien

Kualifikasi:

• Pria
• Min. D3/S1 Peternakan, Dokter Hewan
• IPK Min. 3.00
• Diutamakan memiliki pengalaman min. 1 tahun
• Memahami Budidaya Ayam Broiler
• Bersedia tinggal di Farm
• Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik
• Berorientasi pada hasil/target
• Bisa bekerjasama dengan Tim

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

- Develop and maintain client relationships.
- Execute sales plan of actions as deployed from superior on monthly and quarterly basis (include plan of customer visit, expenses, sales target per outlet/customer, etc).

- Mengembangkan dan mempertahankan hubungan dengan klien.
- Melaksanakan rencana aksi penjualan yang diberikan oleh atasan secara bulanan dan triwulanan (termasuk rencana kunjungan pelanggan, pengeluaran, target penjualan per outlet/pelanggan, dll).

KF PT. Kalbe Farma Tbk.
